name: Famous Quotes from Hollywood Hits
description: Questions covering: Casablanca, The Wizard of Oz, Jerry Maguire, Forrest Gump, Gone with the Wind...

questions.question: In the film Casablanca, what city does Rick mention to Ilsa in the famous line about their past?
questions.explanation_correct: The line 'We'll always have Paris' refers to the time they spent together before the occupation.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Rome, Berlin, and Madrid were not the setting for the couple's romantic past in the film.

questions.question: In the line from The Wizard of Oz about not being there anymore, which place is named?
